name: eu-reg-verifier
description: Grounded RAG agent powered by Mistral AI for EU regulations (GDPR): retrieves relevant regulation text, evaluates relevance, answers only from the loaded document with article - or refrains.

paragraphs: Ask a question about the GDPR and get a straight answer tied to the exact article it comes from, or a clear "the text doesn't cover that." Every answer is drawn from the regulation itself and shows its source, so you can trust it and check it in seconds.
Live demo (Cloud Run hosting, password protected)

The regulation text is EU law, so an EU model provider is a natural fit. Mistral also publishes open-weight models, and nothing in rag.py is tied to the hosted API, so the same pipeline can run against a self-hosted model when data cannot leave the buyer's infrastructure. The judge and answer calls are small, well-defined tasks that a compact model handles well, which keeps the cost per question low. More in BUSINESS.md.
features: Answers you can verify. Each answer cites the exact article and shows the source text.
It won't bluff. When the regulation doesn't address your question, it says so instead of inventing an answer.
Straight from the source. Responses come only from the regulation text, not from a model's training data.
Transparent by design. The retrieve → judge → cite pipeline is hand-built and easy to follow end to end.
Your data stays out of it. Emails, IBANs, card numbers and IP addresses are stripped from your question before anything is sent to the model.
